correctness.rationale: For Heisenberg H_m=V⊕kz over F_q, nondegenerate alternating V of dimension 2m, a Lie idempotent has F(z)=λz, F(v)=Av+f(v)z, λ∈{0,1}. λ=1 forces identity; λ=0 forces A an isotropic-image projection rank r≤m and fA=f. Central shears eliminate f, and Sp orbits of (W=im A,K=ker A) are classified by alternating rank 2s on an r-dimensional complement, 0≤2s≤r; the cross pairing W×Y is perfect. Witt decomposition and surjectivity D↦D−D^T in every characteristic (including 2) justify the congruence classification. For each fixed W, q^[r+2r(m−r)+r(r+1)/2] times the number of rank-2s alternating forms yields the stated orbit size; summing gives 1+Σ_r I_{m,r}(q)q^[r(2m−r+1)] total, with 1+Σ_r(⌊r/2⌋+1) orbits. Independent exact finite-field orbit-size recomposition checked q=2,3 and m=1,2, yielding total 14,38,1202,32402 respectively; char2 reasoning is symbolic, not inferred from samples.
